topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or Simple Past – questions
title: Questions: do/does or did?

explanation.tr:
Soru kurarken yardımcı fiil zamanı belirler:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + özne + yalın fiil?
  Do you live here? Does she like music?
• Simple Past: Did + özne + yalın fiil? (tüm öznelerde)
  Did you live here before? Did she like the concert?
• be fiili: Is/Are ↔ Was/Were
  Are you tired? Were you tired yesterday?
• Wh-sorular: Where do you work? Where did you work before?
explanation.tk:
Sorag düzülende kömekçi işlik zamany kesgitleýär:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + eýe + esasy işlik?
  Do you live here? Does she like music?
• Simple Past: Did + eýe + esasy işlik? (ähli eýelerde)
  Did you live here before? Did she like the concert?
• be işligi: Is/Are ↔ Was/Were
  Are you tired? Were you tired yesterday?
• Wh-soraglar: Where do you work? Where did you work before?
explanation.ru:
В вопросе время определяет вспомогательный глагол:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + подлежащее + начальная форма?
  Do you live here? Does she like music?
• Simple Past: Did + подлежащее + начальная форма? (для всех лиц)
  Did you live here before? Did she like the concert?
• Глагол be: Is/Are ↔ Was/Were
  Are you tired? Were you tired yesterday?
• Специальные вопросы: Where do you work? Where did you work before?

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Simple Present or will-future
title: Simple Present or will-future?

explanation.tr:
Gelecekten bahsederken iki önemli kural:
1. Zaman ve koşul cümlelerinde (when, if, before, after, as soon as, until) gelecek anlamına rağmen Simple Present kullanılır; ana cümlede will gelir:
   When I finish, I'll call you. If it rains, we'll stay home.
2. Tarifeler ve resmî programlar Simple Present'tir: The train leaves at 6. The course starts on Monday.
Diğer tahminler, sözler, anlık kararlar will ile: I think he'll come. I'll help you.
explanation.tk:
Geljek barada gürlänimizde iki möhüm düzgün:
1. Wagt we şert sözlemlerinde (when, if, before, after, as soon as, until) geljek manysyna garamazdan Simple Present ulanylýar; esasy bölekde will gelýär:
   When I finish, I'll call you. If it rains, we'll stay home.
2. Tertipnamalar we resmi maksatnamalar Simple Present: The train leaves at 6. The course starts on Monday.
Beýleki çaklamalar, wadalar, pursatdaky kararlar will bilen: I think he'll come. I'll help you.
explanation.ru:
Два важных правила, когда речь о будущем:
1. В придаточных времени и условия (when, if, before, after, as soon as, until) используется Simple Present, хотя смысл будущий; в главной части — will:
   When I finish, I'll call you. If it rains, we'll stay home.
2. Расписания и официальные программы — Simple Present: The train leaves at 6. The course starts on Monday.
Прочие прогнозы, обещания, спонтанные решения — с will: I think he'll come. I'll help you.

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Tenses in English, Statements
title: Choosing the Right Tense: Statements

explanation.tr:
Doğru zamanı seçmek için cümledeki ipuçlarına bak:
• every day, usually, always → Simple Present (She walks to work.)
• now, at the moment, Look! → Present Progressive (She is walking now.)
• yesterday, last…, ago → Simple Past (She walked yesterday.)
• at 8 yesterday, while, when + uzun eylem → Past Progressive (She was walking when…)
• just, already, yet, ever, since, for → Present Perfect (She has just arrived.)
• tomorrow, next…, I think → will / going to (She will walk. She is going to walk.)
explanation.tk:
Dogry zamany saýlamak üçin sözlemdäki alamatlara seret:
• every day, usually, always → Simple Present (She walks to work.)
• now, at the moment, Look! → Present Progressive (She is walking now.)
• yesterday, last…, ago → Simple Past (She walked yesterday.)
• at 8 yesterday, while, when + uzak hereket → Past Progressive (She was walking when…)
• just, already, yet, ever, since, for → Present Perfect (She has just arrived.)
• tomorrow, next…, I think → will / going to (She will walk. She is going to walk.)
explanation.ru:
Чтобы выбрать время, смотри на подсказки в предложении:
• every day, usually, always → Simple Present (She walks to work.)
• now, at the moment, Look! → Present Progressive (She is walking now.)
• yesterday, last…, ago → Simple Past (She walked yesterday.)
• at 8 yesterday, while, when + длительное → Past Progressive (She was walking when…)
• just, already, yet, ever, since, for → Present Perfect (She has just arrived.)
• tomorrow, next…, I think → will / going to (She will walk. She is going to walk.)

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: Tenses in English – Statements and questions
title: Choosing the Right Tense: Statements and Questions

explanation.tr:
Her zamanın soru biçimini karşılaştır:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + özne + fiil? → Does he work?
• Present Progressive: Am/Is/Are + özne + -ing? → Is he working?
• Simple Past: Did + özne + fiil? → Did he work?
• Past Progressive: Was/Were + özne + -ing? → Was he working?
• Present Perfect: Have/Has + özne + V3? → Has he worked?
• will-future: Will + özne + fiil? → Will he work?
• going to: Am/Is/Are + özne + going to + fiil? → Is he going to work?
explanation.tk:
Her zamanyň sorag görnüşini deňeşdir:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + eýe + işlik? → Does he work?
• Present Progressive: Am/Is/Are + eýe + -ing? → Is he working?
• Simple Past: Did + eýe + işlik? → Did he work?
• Past Progressive: Was/Were + eýe + -ing? → Was he working?
• Present Perfect: Have/Has + eýe + V3? → Has he worked?
• will-future: Will + eýe + işlik? → Will he work?
• going to: Am/Is/Are + eýe + going to + işlik? → Is he going to work?
explanation.ru:
Сравни вопросительные формы разных времён:
• Simple Present: Do/Does + подлежащее + глагол? → Does he work?
• Present Progressive: Am/Is/Are + подлежащее + -ing? → Is he working?
• Simple Past: Did + подлежащее + глагол? → Did he work?
• Past Progressive: Was/Were + подлежащее + -ing? → Was he working?
• Present Perfect: Have/Has + подлежащее + V3? → Has he worked?
• will-future: Will + подлежащее + глагол? → Will he work?
• going to: Am/Is/Are + подлежащее + going to + глагол? → Is he going to work?

topic: Tenses – Contrasted: will or going to-future
title: will or going to?

explanation.tr:
• will:
  - Konuşma anında verilen karar: "I'm cold." – "I'll close the window."
  - Görüş/tahmin (I think, probably): I think you'll like it.
  - Söz, teklif, rica: I'll help you. Will you open the door?
• going to:
  - Önceden verilmiş karar/plan: I'm going to paint my room this weekend. (Boyayı aldım bile.)
  - Şimdiki işaretten tahmin: Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.
İpucu: 'zaten karar verildi mi?' Evet → going to; Şimdi karar veriliyor → will.
explanation.tk:
• will:
  - Gürleşip durkaň berlen karar: "I'm cold." – "I'll close the window."
  - Pikir/çaklama (I think, probably): I think you'll like it.
  - Wada, teklip, haýyş: I'll help you. Will you open the door?
• going to:
  - Öňünden berlen karar/meýilnama: I'm going to paint my room this weekend. (Reňki eýýäm satyn aldym.)
  - Häzirki alamatdan çaklama: Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.
Maslahat: 'karar eýýäm berildimi?' Hawa → going to; häzir berilýär → will.
explanation.ru:
• will:
  - Решение в момент речи: "I'm cold." – "I'll close the window."
  - Мнение/прогноз (I think, probably): I think you'll like it.
  - Обещание, предложение, просьба: I'll help you. Will you open the door?
• going to:
  - Решение/план, принятые заранее: I'm going to paint my room this weekend. (Краску уже купил.)
  - Прогноз по признакам: Look at the clouds. It's going to rain.
Подсказка: решение уже принято? Да → going to; принимается сейчас → will.

examples.en: "I'm cold." – "I'll close the window."
I'm going to paint my room this weekend.
